summary: The article accurately reports on the partnership between Air India and IHG Hotels & Resorts, including earning rates, conversion ratios, and the special launch offer. All key factual claims are consistent with authoritative sources.

claims.claim: This new partnership was announced on September 4, 2026.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the announcement date of September 4, 2026.

claims.claim: For example, you will earn 2 Maharaja Points for every US$1 (around ₹83, as of early September 2026) you spend at most IHG hotels.
claims.note: Sources confirm earning 2 Maharaja Points per US$1 at most IHG hotels. The INR conversion is an estimation and not a direct claim from the partnership announcement.

claims.claim: For stays at specific brands like Candlewood Suites or Staybridge Suites, you'll earn 1 Maharaja Point per US$1 spent.
claims.note: Sources confirm this specific earning rate for these brands.

claims.claim: For every 1,000 IHG One Rewards Points you convert, you will receive 200 Maharaja Points.
claims.note: The conversion rate is consistently stated across multiple sources.

claims.claim: There's a minimum conversion of 1,000 IHG One Rewards Points.
claims.note: Sources confirm the minimum conversion threshold.

claims.claim: To celebrate the partnership, Maharaja Club members can earn three times (3x) the Maharaja Points on eligible stays between September 15 and December 31, 2026.
claims.note: The special launch offer and its dates are confirmed by multiple sources.

claims.claim: You need to register for this promotion to get the extra points.
claims.note: Sources explicitly state that registration is required for the triple points promotion.

article_title: Your Travel Just Got More Rewarding: Air India and IHG Join Hands
